scope: Native Git implementation performance mechanisms, with controlled ablation baselines rather than fabricated historical releases

items.name: Native Git backend
items.mechanism: Replace interpreted EYG object decode/parse and effect-rich IO traversal with Zig byte loops and stdlib zlib/SHA while retaining explicit GitQuery effects
items.before: Pinned real-world EYG 20 full records: cold decoded cache median899ms, repeated warm22ms, 3 samples each
items.after: Native20 records median2.7819ms,100 samples, fresh Repository/decoded cache each request, OS cache warm
items.limit: Whole-backend comparison, not attribution to an individual micro-optimisation. Query completions exceed10ms at the tail.

items.name: Lazy validated pack-index loading
items.mechanism: Read directory/index bytes and validate SHA once per Repository; binary lookups share those bytes for all objects in one request.

items.name: Binary OID lookup
items.mechanism: Search sorted 20-byte object IDs logarithmically, after first-byte fanout; baseline scans all entries.

items.name: Fanout search bounds
items.mechanism: Use the256-count cumulative fanout table to search only the bucket for the first hash byte; baseline binary-searches full index.

items.name: Decoded immutable object and delta-base cache
items.mechanism: Cache reconstructed bytes under OID and immutable pack-path/offset keys. Parent/tree/delta reads reuse results within one request. Admission stops at512entries or16MiB accounted bytes. Mutable refs/HEAD/config are never cached.
items.limit: Native cache is request-scoped and admission-bounded, not an LRU or total-arena-memory bound.

items.name: Streaming packed-object reads
items.mechanism: Seek directly to the object's pack offset. A buffered reader feeds zlib only the selected compressed stream and recursively needed bases, rather than copying the entire pack.

items.name: Preallocated delta output
items.mechanism: Decode target size first and reserve one output buffer. Copy each contiguous base span with appendSlice instead of growing/reallocating multiple times.

items.name: Metadata filtering before path IO
items.mechanism: Reject timestamp, message and author nonmatches before reading trees for a path-change test.

items.name: Bounded history traversal
items.mechanism: Stop as soon as enough matching commits exist. Baseline visits the rest of first-parent history before returning the same prefix. scan_limit remains a safety bound.

items.name: Incremental object hashing
items.mechanism: Feed kind, space, size, NUL and object body to SHA incrementally. Avoid an additional full header-plus-body concatenation allocation/copy.
items.limit: Microbenchmark is a1MiB object, not every query size.

items.name: Fast zlib write level
items.mechanism: Zig .fast aliases deflate level4, with smaller match-search budgets than .default level6. Measure CPU and compressed size; full write retains fsync and rename.

items.name: Reuse existing immutable writes
items.mechanism: After deriving the content address, validate an existing object and return its ID instead of recompressing/syncing/publishing another object. Corrupt existing objects still fail.

items.name: Asynchronous Git effect
items.mechanism: Worker owns a snapshot arena and publishes completion with release/acquire. UI renders first feedback while IO/decode continues. Refcounted lifetime lets cancellation/terminal shutdown detach without waiting.
items.after: Message query first feedback3.6376ms, completed result26.149ms
items.limit: Responsiveness improvement, not throughput acceleration. Need parent TUI ablation for blocking-before timing.

changes: power-of-two table instead of repeated list folds
back-reference window O(length+distance) instead of O(length*distance)
compiler correctness fixes enabling pure-code benchmark
prior_real_world_optimisations.limits: These preceded the native port. Their report gives aggregate/historical indicative timings and explicitly does not isolate every change. Do not attribute a shared aggregate speedup to every mechanism or present16ms oracle coalescing as native10ms evidence.
